Name: Shed GreenHouse
Author: ArslanAR24
Description:
Shed to Greenhouse
Turn your Shed into a greenhouse!
This Content Patcher pack replaces the interiors of the regular Shed and Big Shed with custom greenhouse-style layouts. Both interiors are marked as greenhouse locations, making them suitable for growing crops beyond their usual seasons. The Big Shed is configured as a separate building instead of an upgrade to the regular Shed.
FEATURES
[list]
[*]Custom interior for the regular Shed (20 × 23 tiles)[/*]
[*]Larger custom interior for the Big Shed (33 × 35 tiles)[/*]
[*]Greenhouse-style crop-growing locations[/*]
[*]Warps back to the Farm[/*]
[/list]REQUIREMENTS
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive.[/*]
[*]Place the “Shed GreenHouse” folder in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]COMPATIBILITY
Mods that change the Shed or Big Shed interior maps, or edit their location and building data, may conflict with this pack.
The archive uses the game’s existing tilesheets and includes both custom maps.
